Settle the Steam Fluid Drill's oil ledger before you dig: bronze wells start small and modest, steel wells start the same but climb multiples further — the curves live in the tooltip.

Structural discipline is strict: exactly §11§r steam input hatch — bring two and the shape refuses to form.

Survey the field before raising the derrick, and lay the tanks before the oil arrives; the order matters.

§3One good well, half an oil field.§r
